stemMd: A return journey of 120 km takes 2 hours; the outward journey of the same distance takes 3 hours. What is the average speed over both journeys?
explanationMd: Total distance is 240 km and total time 5 hours. Divide totals to get 48 km/h, not the arithmetic mean of the two speeds.

distractorRationale.a: Averages speeds although travel times differ.
